engineering_interpretation: This table defines the Vehicle Lock Status (VehLckSts) signal, detailing its communication parameters and possible states. It is used to verify the correct transmission and interpretation of the vehicle's lock status between the LHZCU and RHZCU modules via the CAN bus, ensuring that the door lock system operates as expected across different locking states.
